body:
From the interface (not yet probed): a session carries a clients count and `zmx detach` detaches all clients, so several clients can be attached to one PTY at once; labels are writable by anyone who can name the session (`zmx set`, from inside or outside), and every reader sees them in `zmx ls`.

That means 'let an agent and me watch or drive the same session' needs no new mechanism — zmx multiplexes, the kernel arbitrates the PTY. 'Let agents tag each other's sessions' needs no new mechanism either; it needs a vocabulary and a reader. See h-shared-world.
title: zmx is already a shared world
